newsitem.title: ITALY: Mondadori says MD left for personal motive.
newsitem.headline: Mondadori says MD left for personal motive.

text.p: Leonardo Mondadori, chairman of publishers Mondadori said the company's managing director Paolo Furlin had resigned for personal reasons.

"The resignation of Paolo Forlin is a personal matter and has nothing to do with any presumed disagreements within the publishing company or with the controlling company," Mondadori said in a statement.
Italian newspapers reported on Tuesday that Forlin had resigned because of disagreements with Mondadori's top management and with its main shareholders, Fininvest.
